title: Akbar Tujay Karbal ki Sehar Dhoond Rahi Hay
body:
Tujay Jai Say Muazan Ko (x2) Fajr Dhoond Aai Ri Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aai Meray Jawan Laal Zara Dekh Kay Jaana (x2)
Barchi Tera Maqtal Main (x2) Jigar Dhoond Rahee Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhie Nana Kay Rozay Pai Kabhie Babay Shahair Sai (x2)
Sughra Teray Aah Nay Ki (x2) Khabar Dhoond Rahee Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Dekha Shabab Aisa Na Hai Deykhee Jawanee (x2)
Khood Maut Bee Ab Tera (x2) Hijar Dhoond Rahee Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hayraan Hai Sabee Lowg Teray Laashay Pay Qasim (x2)
Maa Khoon Kee Gataree Mai (x2) Pisar Dhoond Rahee Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaan Soya Garam Rait Pay Ai Chaand Say Asghar (x2)
Maa Teri Anderyron Mai (x2) Qabar Dhoond Rahee Hay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mushkil Hoowa Qaidee Say To Bayhoshee Mai Chalna (x2)
Adil Har Zanjeer (x2) Safr Dhoond Rahee Hay.
